name: Gameday
description: A small live score bar for your team's game, drawn over the kiosk. Reads a TeamTracker sensor from Home Assistant.
author: Mike Janofsky

settings.title: Team sensor
settings.description: The TeamTracker sensor for your team, e.g. sensor.tampa_bay_rowdies.

settings.title: Show upcoming game (hours before)
settings.description: How long before the start the bar appears with the start time. 0 shows it only once the game starts.

settings.title: Keep final score (minutes)
settings.description: How long the final score stays up after the game ends. 0 hides the bar at the end of the game.

settings.title: Style
settings.description: Crests shows each team's logo in its colors. Text shows abbreviations tinted in team colors.

settings.title: Goal confetti
settings.description: How the confetti plays after the ball lands: falling across the bar, drifting out of the badge, or twinkling stars.

settings.title: Show over the screensaver
settings.description: Draw over the screensaver, the menu and camera views. Notifications and announcements still cover the bar.

settings.title: Preview
settings.description: Show sample data to try the position and size. Turn off for normal use.
